restrictions: Two distinct 64-byte messages M(x), M(y). W0..W7 are the fixed prefix in proof Section 1; W8=y0, W9=y1; W10..W15 add the fixed offsets dbce7a42, aaf3823d, 8d41a28c, 7f214e02, 2423f959, 7e640e8c. The target uses the standard IV, exactly 45 steps on both padded blocks, feed-forward, and all 256 output bits.

The walk is g(x)=walkB(state_45(M(x))) XOR q with published q=88672517e5bc051968d5d7fb3762dd7c07a6ead1e4b8af9f0dc040edce832890. The output registers already hold g. A collision of g implies equal complete digests.

Classical 256-bit word RAM under collision-frontier-v5, reference_operation_cost=3316. The machine has 1024 registers. Body records cost five code bytes and one operation; other instructions cost 36 bytes.
Preprocessing is 462181911979141425 operations and includes the wasm emitter plus the complete 1641-candidate offset and selector search envelopes. preprocessing_log2 rounds upward to 46.98602.
Peak memory is 1048572 bytes; setup peaks at 648711 bytes. Every table and code field fits its declared width.

The normative embedded C source has SHA-256 862a0b6e95135f37bfcebdf0bfc58efe0a8edf0197c9c809e98f1d611595778e; stripped wasm SHA-256 5431908656b71dbc8aa03149c5c541563cdb29ca8a59950515f937456a3a29ae; emitted SLP SHA-256 e22cde802ca5be3c6dd82f3a8392f62be305008c000491d76e99d9b0e061367d. The organizer executes the packaged Python byte-exact mirror; wasm accounting is participant-run.
For a uniformly random function, the bounded-restart calculation in proof Section 2 gives P_F at least 0.390000001000. H1 is the only score-critical premise and is declared, not proved.

heuristics.statement: The fixed walk succeeds at least as often as the exact bounded attempt against a lazy-sampled uniformly random 256-bit function. Fresh outputs retain collision hazard 2^-256, the first-collision law of a random mapping, independent DP density, and the same hazard after conditioning on the adaptive history.
heuristics.scope: The sha256-r45-prefix-v1 target, the 64-byte message family in proof Section 1, about 2^128 evaluations, and 256 simultaneous trails.
heuristics.extrapolation: The experiments check program correctness at width 16 and full-width projections, and compare one fixed width-20 projection with shared-function random-mapping ensembles. Extrapolation to the full attempt is by H1 only.
heuristics.limitations: H1 is a model premise about one fixed function, not a theorem. The experiments do not observe full-width collisions or estimate the claimed probability.
